name: Lightly
tagline: Computer-vision data curation, labeling, and model pretraining.
description: Lightly is a computer-vision data platform that helps teams curate the most informative samples from large image and video datasets using embeddings, active learning, and near-duplicate detection. Its suite spans LightlyStudio (curation and labeling), LightlyTrain (self-supervised pretraining and fine-tuning of vision models), and LightlyEdge (smart data selection on devices). The aim is to cut labeling cost by training on the data that actually improves models.
insight: Grew out of LightlySSL, the team's open-source self-supervised-learning framework for computer vision.

modelSupport.notes: Works with your vision models; LightlyTrain pretrains and fine-tunes them.

edge: Curation-first: picks the most informative frames via embeddings and active learning so you label and train on less data.
pros: Open-source SSL library to build on
cons: Focused on vision, not other modalities
